title: RECLAMATION ALGORITHM [FIRE WITHIN THE SAND]
lines: DETAILS ： Reclamation Algorithm [Fire Within The Sand] will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain Badges of Prosperity according to the progress of your current algorithm and raise the level of [Prosperity Gradient] to collect event rewards.
MAIN REWARDS ： EPOQUE Collecti on New Arrivals - A Drip of Orea and Potamous for Pallas, Headhunting Permit, Event Furniture, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, etc.
